long_description:
Join Nikhil and Sabhatina in Seattle for an in-person Bollywood dance workshop packed with fun moves and great vibes!

About this Event

Desi Hip Hop Workshop with Nikhil and Tina (Seattle, WA)Get ready to dance and have a blast at our in-person Workshop with the amazing Nikhil and Tina right here in Seattle! Whether you’re a beginner or a pro, join us for some fun. Don’t miss out on this chance to learn authentic Bollywood dance steps and make new friends!
Song - Don'u Don'u Don'u (From "Maari")
About Nikhil:
Nikhil Teja Achi has been dancing since he was six years old. He started with Tollywood and Bollywood dance until 2014, and then he was introduced to hip hop, house, locking, Afro, dancehall, and various other styles through his collegiate dance crew. After completing his bachelor’s, he pursued his interest in street styles by training in various forms in India.
About Tina Selvam:
Tina Selvam's dance journey began with an innate love for hip-hop, learning through YouTube, and a deep fondness for Bollywood that grew through community performances. Over the last two years, she has been exploring hip-hop, house, and other foundational styles within Seattle’s vibrant dance community, constantly learning, unlearning, and growing.
